info.name: Doma Protocol Events Poll API API
Poll for new Doma Protocol events

params.name: cursor
params.description: Cursor identifier to use for tracking the polling state. Can be used to manage multiple independent polling states.

params.name: eventTypes
params.description: Filter events by type. Can be provided multiple times to filter by multiple types.

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of events to return in a single response page.

params.name: includeSynthetics
params.description: Whether to include synthetic token events.

params.name: finalizedOnly
params.description: Whether to return only finalized events.

items.docs: Returns blockchain events that have occurred since the last acknowledged event.

params.name: lastEventId
params.description: Last event id that was processed by the client.

items.docs: Updates the last acknowledged event id for the client.

params.name: eventId
